findings.message: The behaviour of hexadecimal numeric strings was inconsistent prior to PHP 7 and support has been removed in PHP 7. Found: "0x142864" (PHP 7.0 change that only affects numeric comparison or arithmetic on hex strings such as "0x1A"; code that runs on PHP 7 or 8 today already has this behaviour)
